gloss: to be all present, to be complete

definitions.gloss: to be all present, to be complete, to all come together
definitions.explanation: For all expected members, items, or elements to have arrived or appeared. Implies that the full set is now assembled.

examples.japanese: メンバーが{出揃|でそろ}った。
{各社|かくしゃ}の{新製品|しんせいひん}が{出揃|でそろ}った。
examples.english: New products from all the companies have come out.

examples.japanese: {候補者|こうほしゃ}が{出揃|でそろ}ったところで、{選挙戦|せんきょせん}が{本格的|ほんかくてき}に{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Once all the candidates had come forward, the election campaign began in earnest.

notes:
A compound verb from {出|で}る (to come out) + {揃|そろ}う (to be complete/aligned). Often used in news and business contexts to describe the completion of a set.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{顔ぶれ|かおぶれ}が{出揃|でそろ}う (all faces are gathered)
・{結果|けっか}が{出揃|でそろ}う (all results are in)
・{役者|やくしゃ}が{出揃|でそろ}う (all actors are assembled; the stage is set)
